## What I would look for

For a really beautiful, fluffy hotel-quality comforter\:

- 700–850+ fill power
- 100% goose down rather than a feather/down blend
- Baffle-box construction to prevent cold spots
- 100% cotton shell, preferably sateen
- Responsible Down Standard (RDS) certification
